fields.description:
# PL-7: System / Integration Fields

_Back-end identifiers and review markers on the Player record — mostly system-populated, not manually edited._

### FIELDS

* Player ID
* Player External ID
* Source System
* Source Reference
* Review Required — Checkbox

* A marker, not a status. Raised by a fraud flag on this player or by Ops checking it manually; cleared by Ops. Drives a banner on the record while the player keeps working normally. An incomplete profile does not set it.

* Review Reason — Text, required when Review Required is checked

* Names the fraud flag or the concern behind the check.

* First Completed Sign-Up — Lookup to Sign Up
* Last Activity Date — Date
* Account Record Type
* CMS Last Sync — Datetime

### IMPLEMENTATION REQUIREMENTS

* Not separately confirmed in the Aug 18 transcript

* Sourced from the prototype only — no meeting quote to cite. Flag for a quick confirm with Kobi if anything looks off once you're in the object.

* Last Activity Date feeds PL-8's 90-day inactivity automation

* Needs a defined list of qualifying "activity" events before that automation can be built (see PL-8's open question).

### NOTES

* Provenance: PL-7 (Player Record User Stories doc).

### SOURCE

* [Taryn doc PL-7 — Player Record User Stories](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1OSqt7ilS1feVS7aVxAYSsBZIcTrc1J31_WnQiVucEJg/edit)
* Dependencies: [BUILD-173 — Player: Core Details fields](https://app.asana.com/1/1202721605677544/project/1215732799516730/task/1217684264652851)
* Owner (proposed): Taryn Reithofer
* Remember to update the requirements documentation as part of this change.
* Created 2026-08-20 from Player record documentation review.

comments.body:
* First Completed Sign-Up — Lookup to Sign Up

Flow still needs implementing:

**Steps:**

1. Get the related Player record via the Sign Up's Player lookup.
2. Decision — Is Player.First Completed Sign-Up blank?

* **No** → Stop. This isn't the player's first completed Sign Up, so nothing changes.
* **Yes** → Continue:

* 3. Update the Player record:

* Set **First Completed Sign-Up** = this Sign Up's record.
* Decision — Is Player Status currently "Pending"?

* **Yes** → also set **Player Status = Active**.
* **No** → leave Player Status alone (still stamp First Completed Sign-Up either way).

[@Kobi Kunasekaran](https://app.asana.com/1/1202721605677544/profile/1203115293332591) Do Source System / Source Reference serve a different purpose than Player External ID, or is one of them redundant?
create a ticket to find a way to populate the field for "possible duplicate flag"

**Flagged fields:** Source System, Source Reference for clarification in slack

[https://jumpr-solutions.slack.com/archives/C0BBC05C2HG/p1787595388887289](https://jumpr-solutions.slack.com/archives/C0BBC05C2HG/p1787595388887289)

**Result:** The client has requested to remove these fields. 

**Still outstanding:** per an existing comment on this ticket, the flow logic for First Completed Sign-Up (stamping the field and conditionally updating Player Status) still needs implementing. As well as, CMS Last Sync field logic and Last Activity Date.
The above is now broken out into BUILD252 and BUILD-253. Added as dependencies.
